patch.title: Flaky Opens a Bureka Window in South Beach in October 2026
patch.description: Flaky is operating at The Fifth Hotel in South of Fifth by October 23, 2026. Its exact first service day remains unverified.

October31 is a month-precision marker, not a verified upcoming opening day. Aggregator snippets disagree on earlyOctober versus October23.

patch.title: Happy Medium Books Café Plans Its Riverside Relocation
patch.description: The established bookstore-café plans a move from 2724 to 2756 Park Street. An October 2026 reopening target is reported; the exact new-branch opening day remains unverified.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Estimated: September reports describe a relocation of a bookstore-café established in2023, with reopening at2756ParkStreet expected inearlyOctober2026. The October31 timestamp is a month marker. October23 reporting separately describes Mixed Fillings’ forthcoming café partnership, not proof of the relocated store’s first service day.
